verdict.rationale: Brex documents multi-entity, multi-currency operation: budgets and spend limits in 100+ currencies with localized policies for entities, local statement payments to avoid intercompany transactions, cards issued in 60+ countries, and a legal_entity_id dimension in the API. There is no explicit evidence of consolidated cross-entity reporting or separate per-entity books/ledgers. Missing for 10: documented consolidated reporting across entities, per-entity books/accounting sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.
